config.protocol: Phase-2.8 audit protocol: same state-level split, controller candidate excluded, audit regressors (OLS / RandomForest / HistGradientBoosting) per horizon, pairwise AUC and win-count Kendall from experiments.action_identifiability_audit

data.split_unit: state = (problem, seed, generation); shared by every target

signature.definition: per (state, action, horizon): statistics of the advantage of rows in the same signature bucket (operator x multiplier quartile x exploration quartile, bins fitted per operator) that belong to OTHER states of the aggregation source; empty buckets are filled with zeros (rank 0.5), never with a global mean, so no state information leaks into the feature

gate.evidence: pairwise AUC 0.528 <= 0.53 at h=20: the signature representation does not restore identifiability (baseline action_only AUC 0.5247760443183747)
